full_page.content:
1922, December 31
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C.F.M.Cap.
December 31st 1922
To My Dear Brother Patrick
Merry Christmastide God's Blessing for the New Year! B. Fr. Solanus, O.M. Cap. Praised Be Jesus Christ!
Our Lady Queen of Angels 226 E.113 St. N.Y. City, N.Y.
December 31st 1922
My Dear Brother Patrick:
Just a line this busy eve to wish you God's Blessing for a Happy New Year. Love, Best wishes, God's Grace To All.
Deo Gratias!
